title: Oven Roasted Vietnamese Tofu Che Ba Mau
description: A fresh and snappy Vietnamese dish featuring tofu and a variety of flavors, perfect for a post-workout meal. This recipe is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly and served in a salt block vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut oil, lemongrass, garlic, ginger, tamari, maple syrup, rice vinegar, salt, and black pepper.
Add the tofu cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Line a salt block vessel with parchment paper and arrange the tofu cubes in a single layer.
Roast the tofu in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the tofu from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the tofu hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Reheat the tofu in the oven or on the stovetop before serving.
